name: v18 Formal M2 Full-Model Quantization and Model-Level Evaluation

quantization.scope: all 168 decoder Linear modules; embeddings, tied lm_head, norms, and biases remain FP16
quantization.math: FP32 GPTQ statistics and compensation; dense quantized weights stored FP16

m2.selection_unit: independent alpha per output row, shared across all G128 groups of that row
m2.objective: direct local calibration output reconstruction MSE, X @ (Q_FP16.float() - W_FP16.float()).T
m2.tie_break: exact loss ties prefer the larger alpha
m2.prefix: the method's own previously committed dense quantized weights; q/k/v and up/gate use shared group input/H; refresh only at dependency boundaries
m2.candidate_isolation: all ten candidates use the same pristine current target W and shared H/Hinv state; candidate-local compensation state is fresh

calibration.source: v16 CALIBRATION_MANIFEST.json, copied byte-for-byte to this run directory

evaluation.primary_representation: dense-dequant FP16 weights for M1 and M2; original FP16 for M0
evaluation.c4_label: C4 validation fixed token budget PPL; not standard/full C4 PPL

gate.source: v16 frozen protocol and v17.3 corrected cost audit
